It seems like one big problem with game changer discussions is that nobody is very aligned on what the point of the distinction actually is. There are people on one side saying that Grand Arbiter Augustin should be a GC because it's awful to play against in bracket 2, and others saying that cards should be a GC specifically because they're a piece of a cEDH combo, but in bracket 2 they aren't as crazy.

We should be approaching this as "should the card be banned in bracket 2 and limited in bracket 3", as that's the main mechanical limitation.

The main problem with GA is how much it warps the board state if it's not immediately answered, especially as a commander. Making all spells your opponents cast cost more while the ones you're casting cost less is extremely oppressive. Completely messes up tempo, and in a game where missing a single land drop can set you back a lot, having to find ANOTHER source of mana after this hits the field is very much in the "feels bad" section of cards.

Not to mention the colors it's in, which have some of the strongest control options in the game.
